title: Ops & Cost
description: Iterations, LLM calls/tokens, latency percentiles, and safety-net trip counts.

panels.title: Iterations per Ticket (Distribution)
panels.description: Graph-loop iteration_count per ticket -- since there is no fixed retry cap, this distribution is the real signal for whether the Continuation Agent is looping more than expected.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT iteration_count
FROM `ticket_analytics.fact_ticket_events`
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts) AND iteration_count IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Avg LLM Calls & Tokens per Ticket
panels.description: Real cost proxies for a self-hosted Ollama pipeline (no per-token billing to report -- see bigquery_sink.py's estimated_cost_usd note).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(event_ts, DAY) AS time, AVG(llm_call_count) AS avg_llm_calls
FROM `ticket_analytics.fact_ticket_events`
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(event_ts, DAY) AS time, AVG(total_tokens) AS avg_total_tokens
FROM `ticket_analytics.fact_ticket_events`
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Latency Percentiles (p50/p95/p99)
panels.description: Total LLM latency per ticket (sum of every agent call's latency_ms, from app/llm/ollama_client.py telemetry).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TIMESTAMP_TRUNC(event_ts, DAY) AS time,
  APPROX_QUANTILES(total_latency_ms, 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS p50,
  APPROX_QUANTILES(total_latency_ms, 100)[OFFSET(95)] AS p95,
  APPROX_QUANTILES(total_latency_ms, 100)[OFFSET(99)] AS p99
FROM `ticket_analytics.fact_ticket_events`
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Wall-Clock / Max-Iteration Safety-Net Trips
panels.description: Count of tickets in the selected window where the engineering safety net (not the agentic Continuation Agent) forced escalation -- see anomaly_flags in app/agents/supervisor.py's _safety_net_reason. Should be zero or near-zero in steady state; a nonzero, rising count means real agentic loops aren't converging and needs investigation, not a threshold bump.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNTIF(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM UNNEST(anomaly_flags) AS flag WHERE flag LIKE '%safety_net%')) AS safety_net_trips
FROM `ticket_analytics.fact_ticket_events`
WHERE $__timeFilter(event_ts)
